notes.title: Update 0.4.1.2
notes.content:
Please note: Due to the world map position bug mentioned below, your position in the world map will be reset to the divinator tower upon first load. After this initial reset should work as normal

UI
	
 Add crafting filter to inventories to better contain items for combining, add sort icon to sort button
 	Updated exit button graphic
 	Rework panel that pops up when at location in world map


Removed the default Inverted camera approach on the minimap
Rock spider makes sounds on attack

Fixes

 	Goat demon, human, corrupted, snail, hyga demon and others not playing blood particle effect on hit

 	Sacrifice process bugging out when at very low FPS (< 15)
 	Cannot pick up certain paper items
 	Broom inventory icon very small
 	Player on inventory hold bow wrong
 	Cannot exit save prompt without something typed in
 	Rune screen showing incorrect runes on your equipment when switching pages
 	Bug where shuffling save files (loading one save, then starting a new game save) could make the position on the world map retain from previous save files

	
	Various other minor fixes

notes.title: Crypt Lord 0.4.1.1
notes.content:
0.4.1 Patch Notes

General:

Enemy AI reworked. More reliable pathfinding and less clunkiness in navigating the world.
Reworked demon chicken & Archer AI to be more dynamic and intelligent.
Head Tracking reworked, fixed weird head falling down issue.
Enemies slow their attacks when the target is blocking.


Arrows:

Chance to break upon hitting a target. Makes bows less OP.
Associated runes: Find a rune to increase your arrow durability, or a rune of power shot to do massive damage but a surefire way to break your arrow.
Arrow physics reworked, making it a little easier to pick up and less prone to weird physics after dropping.
Added new arrow - DryShard, Crafted by combining twig bush branch and new DryShard ingredient.
Bow stamina values balanced.
Fix bow doing double damage under certain circumstances


Display:

Increased display time of some text in intro cutscene.


Blocking:

Blocking re-balanced.
Added a rune to improve blocking percentage.


Ambient Occlusion:

New Ambient occlusion system. More performant for better results and fewer weird issues.


Dialogue:

NPC mouth talk animation during dialogue.
NPC is no longer completely frozen during dialogue.
Urn dialogue sounds different from humans.


Rune Casting:

Sound plays when charging rune.
Added notification when not enough prayer points.


Fixes:

Minimap arrow to show player can disappear sometimes.
Player on world map starts back at divinator tower sometimes.
See-through effect when player is obscured on WM showing throw armor.
Lighting issues.
Balanced spawn weights of items.
Human idle in non-combat doesn't loop correctly.
Prayer points clamped to 99 at max.
Various AI issues.
Runes not spawning at the correct level.
